paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in Shekalim, chapter 1, halakhah 1, according to the text printed with the Babylonian Talmud; in the Jerusalem Talmud, R' Abba.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Tractate Shekalim of the Jerusalem Talmud is also printed in editions of the Babylonian Talmud; Hyman contrasts the two printed texts.

The Guggenheimer digital paragraph of Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 1:1 has Rabbi Ba bar Acha (רבי בא בר אחא). Hyman’s Biva and Abba forms and his comparison of the texts are reported without harmonizing them. The source-abbreviated heading remains R'; the Shekalim text printed with the Bavli has not been freshly collated here.
